justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/NamingStrategy.java` and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/NamingStrategyTest.java`. `PrefixingRandom` is a very small single-purpose inner class: it has only 2 fields (`prefix`, `randomString`), 1 constructor, and 1 overridden `name(TypeDescription)` method that just concatenates the prefix, superclass name, and a random token. The other naming operations are inherited unchanged from `AbstractBase`, and the tests cover only this single naming behavior. No evidence of multiple responsibilities or a need to split the class.
